summary_en: LEC revised FY2027 dividend guidance to 38 yen per share, adding a 10 yen commemorative dividend at fiscal year-end to mark its 30th anniversary of listing. Full-year dividend comprises 14 yen interim and 24 yen year-end (14 yen ordinary plus 10 yen commemorative). Net income forecast was lowered due to yen weakness, rising raw material costs, and increased R&D spending.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (30th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend) for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
LEC, Inc. revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company announced a special commemorative dividend of 10 yen per share at fiscal year-end to celebrate its 30th anniversary of listing on June 7, 2026. The full-year dividend forecast was raised to 38 yen per share, comprising an interim dividend of 14 yen and a year-end dividend of 24 yen (14 yen as ordinary dividend plus 10 yen as commemorative dividend), compared to the previous guidance of 28 yen per share.

Simultaneously, LEC downwardly revised its earnings forecasts for fiscal 2027. Net income attributable to parent company shareholders was lowered by 900 million yen (30% decrease) to 2.1 billion yen, primarily due to three factors: continuing yen weakness expected in the fourth quarter onwards, rising raw material and fuel costs stemming from prolonged Middle East conflicts, and increased R&D and other operating expenses related to the planned launch of "AI Charmy," an interactive AI-equipped plush toy. Sales revenue was raised modestly by 2.0 billion yen to 72.5 billion yen, reflecting solid performance in character-related products, but this was offset by reduced profitability at the operating and net income levels.
